# Anne Conway

*1631 – 1679 · English*

An English philosopher close to the Cambridge Platonists, she conceives a world of living substances, against the dualism of [Descartes](../philosophers/descartes.md) and the materialism of [Hobbes](../philosophers/hobbes.md). [Leibniz](../philosophers/leibniz.md) praised her treatise.
